title: LC-SPEED 7整车
notes: Opened public detail from the manufacturer account visibly states complete-bike weight claims of 7.8 kg for the 7120 configuration, 7.5 kg for 7170, and 7.2 kg for 8170. These are configuration-specific social-post claims retained for the separate Speed7 candidate; they are not propagated to the published SPEEDZ variant or treated as a measured universal weight.
